locomo_monitor.reason: M2 does not touch the LoCoMo code path. LoCoMo observations do not set Observation.subject_id or Observation.entity_id, so the observe-time tag merge is a no-op (no scope tags appended). LoCoMo recall calls pass no scope kwarg, so the scope=None branch is taken, which routes through _recall_hierarchical / reconstruct unchanged. The LoCoMo F1 under M2 is therefore BYTE-IDENTICAL to the M1 content-hash run (0.440). Re-running would consume LLM budget to confirm substrate-level non-divergence that is already provable by code inspection.
